notes: Qty 59 as published: the 'Destiny 7's (13)' header counts 13 but 12 cards are listed under it (the other headers add up).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': the Objective, Epic Duel, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Crush The Rebellion and Mobilization Points; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Section headers ('Starting', 'Sites', 'Destiny 7's' etc.) are not cards. Visage Of The Emperor appears twice in the list (1 starting + 2 under 'Destiny 7's' = 3).

Posted 'Death Star Docking Bay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Cloud City East Platform' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Emperor Palpitine' Emperor Palpatine; 'Moblization Points' Mobilization Points; Intruder Missile is the Dark Special Edition starship weapon.
